data.body:
Root cause confirmed and fix pushed as Gerrit 3259 (patch set 1, 3b00a2350ba94fdccc176d91ab8ce1c715453d7b).

Reproduced in a sandbox store before the fix: a bug linked caused_by a valid origin, closed with caused_by=<origin's first quad> while a second ticket shared that quad. The close succeeded and the edge became caused_by -> '<quad>'. An unknown id gave the same result.

Fix: transition_compute calls the new resolve_explicit_caused_by before any write. A non-blank close --caused-by that does not resolve to exactly 1 ticket raises CommandError (exit 1) naming the candidates, and nothing is written. _resolve_caused_by_culprit no longer falls back to the raw value.

Evidence, worktree fix-herring with .venv/bin first on PATH:
- tests/unit/test_caused_by_unresolved_herring.py: 4 of 5 failed before the fix (2 DID NOT RAISE, missing function, raw '51b0' returned); the unique-short-id control passed. All 5 pass after.
- The 4 existing caused_by/close modules plus the new one: 52 passed.
- Every test module that mentions caused_by, transition_compute, or close_ticket (38 modules, -m 'not integration and not external'): 852 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0.
- make lint exit 0; make typecheck exit 0 (753 source files).

import_ndjson.py also calls transition_compute but passes no caused_by, so the blank short-circuit leaves imports unchanged (covered by test_blank_caused_by_is_not_validated).

Discovered and filed: primitive-flowered-panther, the close path skips the no-referencing-commit refusal that rebar link enforces.
